q: What should our sales team say when a buyer asks about our carbon footprint?
title: Carbon answers for the sales team
short: Give them three approved lines: our latest Scope 1 and 2 figure with the year, how it was calculated, and the next step such as Scope 3 or a target. Anything beyond that goes to the person who owns the data. Sales should never promise a figure, label or certificate you do not have.

ul: Our 2025-26 Scope 1 and 2 emissions were X t CO2e, from our fuel invoices and electricity bills.
We are adding Scope 3 this year; the data owner can share details.
We are carbon neutral, unless it is true and documented.
Our footprint is lower than competitors, without a like-for-like basis.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure behind a claim traceable to the invoices and bills it came from, so a reader can check the number rather than take the wording on trust.

sources.label: ISO 14021, Environmental labels and declarations: self-declared claims (iso.org)
